cards.design_implication: If studying high-Tc superconducting grain boundaries for application-oriented purposes, consider designs that explicitly account for their distinct electronic properties compared to conventional metallic superconductors.
does_not_establish: Specific mathematical models or detailed physical mechanisms behind the unique electronic properties.
Quantitative data on how these properties affect device performance.
cards.evidence_excerpt: Unique electronic properties, different from those of the grain boundaries in conventional metallic superconductors, have made grain boundaries formed by high-${T}_{\mathrm{c}}$ cuprates important tools for basic science. They are moreover a key issue for electronic and large-scale applications of high-${T}_{\mathrm{c}}$ superconductivity.
limitations: This is an abstract-level statement and does not specify which unique electronic properties are relevant or how they manifest.
The excerpt describes general importance rather than a detailed physical mechanism.
cards.statement: Grain boundaries in high-Tc superconductors possess unique electronic properties that distinguish them from grain boundaries in conventional metallic superconductors, making them important for basic science and key issues for applications.
